title: Angelica — Specialty Cropportunities

title: How to grow angelica
scope: RHS garden guide for Angelica species, with Angelica archangelica-specific culinary, root-disturbance and flowering notes; states angelica is unsuitable for containers because of its deep taproot, recommends moist but well-drained soil and outdoor spacing, describes cutting back after flowering, and notes A. archangelica may persist another year if flowers are removed before seed set; regional UK context

title: The Care and Handling of Cut Flowers (HLA-6426)

General guidance recommends clean, sanitized buckets and sharp tools and notes morning harvest may be advantageous. It does not establish cultivar-specific vase life or household vase-life guarantees
